events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on October 8, 1971, in the UK, following its US release on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's 55th Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as powerfully today. Which lyric sticks with you most?

events.title: The first iPod was released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music with '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod's Quarter-Century
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years ago, Apple dropped this game-changer and put a thousand songs in our pockets. What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy 007 Day!
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the extraordinary life and music of John Lennon. A true icon whose impact is still felt today.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, and writer, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Fawlty Towers' to Monty Python, what's your favourite moment from the comedy icon?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, marking a diverse and experimental period for the band.

angles.name: White Album's 58th
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that broke all the rules. What's your standout track?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we said goodbye to the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his presence, his legacy – forever etched in rock history.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, showcasing a significant evolution in their songwriting and sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that changed everything. Which track from this masterpiece still sounds fresh to you?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon today, whose music and message continue to inspire generations.
